verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should (brand, can, headline, CTA) and the headline is the clear focal point. However, the NEW FLAVOR badge is oversized and competes with the headline. The body copy is squeezed into a narrow five-line column, and the logo sits off-centre inside the decorative circle. In B, the left-hand text stack is jammed against the top and bottom edges, and the CTA pill is so big that it outweighs the headline. The SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to an illegible speck floating in the middle, and the can is pushed into the right corner, leaving a lopsided dead zone in the centre.
